regime_context: The China A-shares detector shows leadership concentrated in Cyclicals & Resources (Gold Miners #1, Industrial Metals #2) with a razor-thin margin, narrow eligible breadth (10/22 themes) and low absorption (0.33). The absolute-trend gate historically whipsawed this mean-reverting tape (gate_helps false), so the trend discipline is experimental. Track record is weak (32% directional accuracy), requiring low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Industrial Metals (cn_metals) overtakes Gold Miners (cn_gold) in the normalized momentum score for 5 consecutive days—the current margin is only 0.018, and a sustained crossover would confirm a leadership handoff in the rotation radar.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals has the strongest combination of high momentum rank (#2, score 1.367), strong durability (bar 0.87), cohesive breadth (0.923), a clear trending Hurst regime, and no crowding flag (z 0.1). It is eligible per the trend gate and is the highest-ranked scorable theme, offering a more testable vehicle than unscorable Gold Miners. The detector does not predict returns, but this leg suggests the trend is currently intact and participation is broad—a favorable condition for a modest tactical overweight, given the guardrails.
evidence: rank=2 with momentum score 1.385→1.367, close behind Gold
theses.dissent: China's historically mean-reverting tape and high unscheduled macro surprise share (0.94) can abruptly reverse commodity trends; the absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown in this market's backtest.
